name: IBM Watson Speech to Text
tagline: Streaming and batch speech recognition with customization for accurate audio-to-text conversion.
description: IBM Watson Speech to Text converts audio to written text. It provides real-time WebSocket streaming and synchronous or asynchronous HTTP transcription, plus speaker labels and custom language models. Current large speech and next-generation models do not support acoustic-model customization. Common uses include transcription, live captions, voice interfaces, and speech analytics. Access is through IBM Cloud IAM credentials and region-specific endpoints.

auth.details: IBM Cloud IAM API key via Authorization: Bearer {token} or apikey:{api_key} Basic auth; create service instance and credentials in IBM Cloud.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Lite plan: 500 minutes/month free (verify current on IBM Cloud pricing)
pricing.paid_plans: Plus and Premium plans with higher minutes and features; pricing varies by region and usage.

rate_limits: Plus plan: maximum 100 concurrent transcription requests across HTTP and WebSocket interfaces combined.
use_cases: transcribe uploaded audio file to text
stream microphone audio for live captions
recognize speech with custom language model
convert call-center audio to searchable transcripts
